s1.syndrome_frame: Widespread skin condition with progressive worsening and characteristic plaques
salient_findings: Widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale
key_facts: The patient is a 32-year-old woman
The skin condition has progressively worsened
The condition involves 90% of her body surface area
There are widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques on the trunk and extremities
The plaques have a double-edged scale
Eyebrow hairs are sparse and less than 5 mm long
Scalp hairs are coarse and brittle
Skin biopsy showed psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis
Trichography showed nodal swelling, with invagination of the distal hair into the proximal end

shortlist.label: Pityriasis rubra pilaris
shortlist.why_kept: Characteristic psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis and widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques

shortlist.label: Psoriasis vulgaris
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis and double-edged scale on plaques

shortlist.label: Erythroderma
shortlist.why_kept: Involvement of 90% of body surface area and progressive worsening of skin condition

shortlist.label: Exfoliative dermatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Widespread skin involvement and presence of characteristic plaques

shortlist.label: Ichthyosis vulgaris
shortlist.why_kept: Coarse and brittle scalp hairs and sparse eyebrow hairs, suggestive of underlying ichthyosis

raw.rationale: The presence of widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale, sparse and short eyebrow hairs, and coarse and brittle scalp hairs, along with skin biopsy showing psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis, are characteristic features of Pityriasis rubra pilaris.

rejected.label: Psoriasis vulgaris
rejected.why: While the skin biopsy shows psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia, the clinical presentation and trichography findings are more suggestive of Pityriasis rubra pilaris

rejected.label: Erythroderma
rejected.why: Erythroderma is a more generalized condition without the specific plaque morphology and hair findings seen in this patient

rejected.label: Exfoliative dermatitis
rejected.why: Exfoliative dermatitis typically presents with more widespread scaling and erythema without the distinctive plaques and hair changes

rejected.label: Ichthyosis vulgaris
rejected.why: Ichthyosis vulgaris is characterized by dry, scaly skin without the inflammatory plaques and specific hair abnormalities seen in this patient
